ideas.idea: Block other training crawlers (e.g. ClaudeBot) in robots.txt to match trainingCrawlers: block
ideas.why: The config says block training crawlers but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the policy is only partly applied.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page/URL linked from /blog
ideas.why: Posts are only titles in a client-rendered list with no addresses, so individual pages would make them findable and quotable.

ideas.idea: List plans and prices as text on the pricing page
ideas.why: The page says only 'Free for up to three people' while the description promises plans for every team size, so concrete text helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Expand the docs page beyond one sentence with bank feed import steps
ideas.why: The docs page has a single sentence and doesn't explain how to import a bank feed, which it tells the reader to do.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD to the home page
ideas.why: No JSON-LD exists so it's accurate, but it's standard advice with modest effect for this small site.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical to /blog (and fix the canonical/noindex mismatch on /pricing)
ideas.why: The /docs canonical is a known problem and the pricing noindex is already known; the /blog canonical is the same kind of fix.
